title: Introduction to Data Visualization with ggplot2

modules.description: Understand the foundational principles of ggplot2 and the grammar of graphics approach to visualization.

lessons.title: Overview of ggplot2 and the Grammar of Graphics
objectives: Understand the layered approach of ggplot2
Learn the core components of the grammar of graphics

modules.title: Creating Common Plot Types with ggplot2
modules.description: Construct essential visualization types such as scatter plots, bar charts, and histograms using ggplot2.

lessons.title: Scatter Plots and Bar Charts
objectives: Create scatter plots and bar charts

lessons.title: Histograms and Other Plot Types
objectives: Interpret plot outputs for data insights

modules.title: Customization, Themes, and Troubleshooting
modules.description: Refine visualizations with themes, annotations, and troubleshoot common visualization challenges.

lessons.title: Customizing Aesthetics and Themes
objectives: Enhance visual clarity for scientific communication

lessons.title: Troubleshooting and Best Practices
objectives: Interpret and resolve common visualization errors
Apply best practices for scientific data communication

learning_objectives: Understand the grammar of graphics and ggplot2's layered approach to visualization
Create common plot types (scatter plots, bar charts, histograms, etc.) using ggplot2
Customize plot aesthetics, themes, and annotations for effective scientific communication
Interpret and troubleshoot common visualization challenges
assumptions: Participants have R installed and basic data manipulation skills
Participants have access to a computer with internet connectivity
